import Foundation.RiemannQuadraticFiniteThreshold
import OAI.NumberTheory.DirichletL.Nonvanishing
import Lean

open OperatorDerivativeRewrite.Foundation
open RiemannQuadraticFiniteThreshold

theorem stardust_upstream_finite_threshold_bound : threshold ≤ (9/32 : ℝ) :=
  threshold_le_seven_eighths (fun _ hs => OAI.riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_seven_eighths_lt_re hs)

theorem stardust_upstream_attained_threshold : ∃ A : ℝ, A ≤ 9/32 ∧
    ∀ t : ℝ, (∀ z : ℂ, RiemannEvenFlow.flow 1 t z = 0 → z.im = 0) ↔ A ≤ t :=
  ⟨threshold,stardust_upstream_finite_threshold_bound,real_zeros_iff⟩

open Lean Elab Command in
run_cmd do
  for name in [``stardust_upstream_finite_threshold_bound, ``stardust_upstream_attained_threshold] do
    let axioms ← Lean.collectAxioms name
    for ax in axioms do
      unless ax == ``propext || ax == ``Classical.choice || ax == ``Quot.sound do
        throwError "Forbidden integrated transitive axiom {ax} in {name}"
    logInfo m!"INTEGRATED ACTUAL THRESHOLD AUDIT PASSED: {name}; {axioms}"

set_option pp.universes true
set_option pp.fullNames true
set_option pp.proofs true
#check @stardust_upstream_finite_threshold_bound
#check @stardust_upstream_attained_threshold
output_unabridged:
INTEGRATED ACTUAL THRESHOLD AUDIT PASSED: stardust_upstream_finite_threshold_bound; [propext,
 Classical.choice,
 Quot.sound]
INTEGRATED ACTUAL THRESHOLD AUDIT PASSED: stardust_upstream_attained_threshold; [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
stardust_upstream_finite_threshold_bound : LE.le.{0}
  OperatorDerivativeRewrite.Foundation.RiemannQuadraticFiniteThreshold.threshold (9 / 32)
stardust_upstream_attained_threshold : ∃ A,
  LE.le.{0} A (9 / 32) ∧
    ∀ (t : ℝ),
      (∀ (z : ℂ), Eq.{1} (OperatorDerivativeRewrite.Foundation.RiemannEvenFlow.flow 1 t z) 0 → Eq.{1} z.im 0) ↔
        LE.le.{0} A t
conclusion: Actual finite attained real threshold <=9/32; actual H_t all zeros real iff threshold<=t, all real t
